title: Overflow checks disabled by unchecked block (solidity) — review required
description: A solidity contract opens an unchecked block. Solidity 0.8 and later checks arithmetic by default, and the unchecked block turns those checks off, so overflow and underflow inside it wrap silently. This lexical rule flags the block; the reviewer confirms every operand inside it is bounded.
remediation: Use checked arithmetic, with unchecked kept to proven-bounded loop counters.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: every unchecked block matches, including loop counters that cannot overflow. Bounds need human review.
